selectors.no-inline.description: Browser selectors and raw Playwright locator/navigation calls never appear inline in fixtures, specs, setup or support code; every element is referenced by repository name.
selectors.no-inline.action: Reference the element by repository name: steps.<verb>('<element>', '<Page>'). If the element is not in tests/data/page-repository.json, add it with live evidence first (selectors.evidence).

selectors.evidence.description: Every new or changed page-repository selector has a live evidence note, or is marked provisional.
selectors.evidence.action: Insert the entry with "provisional": true, run npx achilles-selector-evidence --page <Page> --element <element> --context <north|south> (live inspection first), then drop the flag in the same change; an entry that stays provisional needs a known-issues row.

specs.shape.description: Every new UI spec traces each test title to a written scenario block; frozen directories take no new files.
specs.shape.action: Title the test '<ID> — <scenario title>' with the id of its block in docs/scenarios.md (write or update the block first and lint it), then write the spec from it.

spend.opt-in.description: Specs that place real orders are listed; running one needs a per-command opt-in.
spend.opt-in.action: Prefix the command with SPEND_OPT_IN=1 for an owner-approved run (one per scenario), or use node scripts/run-suite.mjs, which excludes the listed specs unless --include-spend is passed.

secrets.none.description: No email addresses, phone numbers or tokens appear in committed tests, docs, scripts or project skills; only environment variable names do.
secrets.none.action: Replace the value with the name of the environment variable that holds it (e.g. SHOPPER_A_EMAIL) and read it via process.env; placeholders look like <SHOPPER_A_EMAIL>.

process.evidence.description: Commits land with a fresh content-hash verify stamp and, for the current change, its verification report.
process.evidence.action: npm run verify (then commit); for a change with an evidence trail: npm run change:start -- <slug>, fill brief.md, have the verifier write verify.md. Without .factory/current-change (a maintenance commit) only the stamp is checked.

process.state.description: The process-state directory (verify stamp, current-change marker) is written only by the project's own tools.
process.state.action: Never write, move or delete .factory/ files by hand: the stamp is written only by npm run verify and the change marker only by npm run change:start; removing the marker after the last commit of a change is an owner action. Reading them (cat) is fine.
